title: CT Transformer model stratifies nodal metastasis risk in papillary thyroid carcinoma
summary: ThyLNT, a Transformer-based 2.5D deep learning model on preoperative CT, was developed in 1560 patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma from six hospitals. AUC was 0.787 in internal validation and 0.772 to 0.827 across five external cohorts, with calibration and threshold-dependent performance varying by cohort. Multi-omics analyses gave exploratory biological context only. The study is retrospective.
ai_technology: ThyLNT, a 2.5D deep learning model (DenseNet201 encoder with a Transformer) on preoperative CT
organization: Tongji Hospital, Huazhong University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: Training and internal validation at Tongji Hospital and independent testing in five external cohorts from six hospitals in total.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and clinical utility; the multi-omics associations are exploratory; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts nodal metastasis risk from seven CT tumor slices per patient.
